area: Stratford: GER Works yards and running lines (west), Stratford Station and Eastern Junction, Angel Place, Angel Lane and Angel Lane Bridge, Station Road, Stratford Goods Station, William Street, Western Street, Angel Lane south to Salway Road and the Theatre Royal
method: Independent second read (no other reader's file consulted). sheet check; 9 sweep crops at 2x; every candidate confirmed on 7x contact sheets (+-28 px), B.M. digits and the 24·2 rail figure at 12x. A first attempt at this mosaic hit the image request limit and was discarded entirely; this file comes only from the second pass, in which all 9 sweep crops and all 7 zoom sheets loaded and were viewed.
legibility: Good print. Rails cross 24·2 in the SW corner. No sheet join reported by the tool and none seen. No missing tiles; the grey below py 1024 is padding.
